Let \(a_n=f(n)\). From \(f(f(0))=0\) and strict monotonicity, \(f(0)=0\). Then \(f(1)=2\), so \(f(2)=3\), and \(f(3)=6\).

Let \(d_n=a_{n+1}-a_n\). Since \(a_{a_n}=3n\), we get \(d_n\in\{1,2,3\}\). Also
\[
a_{3n}=3a_n \implies d_{3n}+d_{3n+1}+d_{3n+2}=3d_n.
\]
With \(d_0=2,d_1=1,d_2=3\), this recurrence gives for \(n\ge 1\):
\[
d_n=
\begin{cases}
1,& \text{if the leading ternary digit of }n\text{ is }1,\\
3,& \text{if the leading ternary digit of }n\text{ is }2.
\end{cases}
\]
Thus
\[
a_{2010}=d_0+\sum_{i=1}^{2009}d_i.
\]
Now \(2010=2202110_3\). For complete ternary blocks up to \(3^6-1=728\):
\[
\sum_{i=1}^{728}d_i=4(1+3+\cdots+3^5)=4\cdot \frac{3^6-1}{2}=1456.
\]
For \(729\le i\le 2009\): there are \(729\) numbers with leading digit \(1\), and \(552\) with leading digit \(2\), so
\[
\sum_{i=729}^{2009}d_i=729+3\cdot 552=2385.
\]
Therefore
\[
a_{2010}=2+1456+2385=3843.
\]

\[
\boxed{3843}
\]
